one_line: Nvidia faces intense scrutiny over export controls and leadership turmoil while Anthropic targets a massive valuation.

themes.title: Nvidia faces leadership turmoil and export probes
themes.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for a leadership shakeup at Nvidia following Jensen Huang's resignation and an inquiry into illicit chip sales to China. Meanwhile, lawmakers and officials are pushing for stricter export controls and reviewing rules affecting Southeast Asian data centers.

themes.title: Anthropic targets massive valuation in IPO
themes.text: Anthropic's IPO and private placement are heavily oversubscribed as the firm targets a $1.4 trillion fully diluted valuation. The Trump administration also plans to designate major AI firms, including Anthropic and OpenAI, as "national champions" to help them compete globally.

themes.title: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max flagship model
themes.text: Alibaba released the Qwen4-Max flagship model featuring a 2.4T-parameter Mixture of Experts architecture and a 1-million-token context window. In other technical developments, OpenAI used GPT-6 Astra to help form a detailed proof for a lattice definition of the Standard Model.
